description: This file defines the IMiracastService interface for Miracast functionality, including enums, data structures, and notification callbacks within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IMiracastService
classes.description: Interface for Miracast service operations, including enabling/disabling, client connection management, and player state updates.

classes.name: IMiracastService::DeviceParameters
classes.description: Structure holding source and sink device network parameters.

classes.name: IMiracastService::Result
classes.description: Structure indicating success or failure of operations with a message.

classes.name: IMiracastService::INotification
classes.description: Callback interface for Miracast service events such as connection requests and errors.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for Miracast events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Enable or disable the Miracast feature.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Retrieve the current enable status of Miracast.

methods.name: AcceptClientConnection
methods.description: Accept or reject a client connection request.

methods.name: UpdatePlayerState
methods.description: Update the player state for a client.

methods.name: SetP2PBackendDiscovery
methods.description: Set the backend discovery status for P2P.
